item.title: Black Women’s Long Fight For Education Highlighted in Newton History Talk
item.description: Residents gathered at the Newton Free Library on Wednesday to hear Kabria Baumgartner, an award-winning historian of early U.S. history, discuss the legacy of racism in Massachusetts public education.

item.title: Jackson Homestead and Museum Reopens With Sweeping New Exhibit
item.description: Newton’s Jackson Homestead and Museum, also known as the Newton History Museum, reopened on Sunday with a state-of-the-art exhibit on the entirety of the city’s history after over six months of substantial renovations.

item.title: BC’s ACC Tournament Chances Dwindle as BC Falls Again
item.description: After a 76–54 loss to Miami on Saturday, Boston College men's basketball is now on the brink of missing the ACC tournament for the second straight year. With just two games left in the year, what does BC need to avoid that becoming a reality—and what could missing mean for BC head coach Earl Grant's future on the Heights?

item.title: Kapke’s 25 Points Fall Short, BC Loses to Virginia Tech 72–63
item.description: Boden Kapke scored 25 points, but it was not enough for Boston College men's basketball on Tuesday night as the Eagles fell to Virginia Tech 72–63 for their 10th loss in 11 games.

item.title: Duke Downs BC 17–6, Eagles Fall to .500 in ACC Play
item.description: The Eagles (2–4, 2–2 Atlantic Coast) scored just one goal in each of the first two quarters, falling behind 9–2 at half. Duke (5–2, 2–1) didn’t slow after the break, outscoring BC 6–2 in the third quarter to cement a Blue Devils win.

item.title: No. 13 BC Drops Third Straight With 2–1 Loss to No. 17 Massachusetts
item.description: No. 13 Boston College men's hockey failed failed to convert more than once on its 35 shots throughout the night, and No. 17 UMass to avoided a season-sweep from BC in its 2–1 win.

item.title: Second-Half Surge Leads BC Past Cal 15–8
item.description: Boston College women's lacrosse used a big second half to surge past California 15–8 in its game on Saturday and get back above .500 in conference play.

item.title: BC Beats Notre Dame in Season Finale, Misses ACC Tournament for Second Straight Year
item.description: Boston College men's basketball came into its game on Saturday needing a win to keep its season alive. The Eagles did just that, beating Notre Dame 77–69, but the victory would ultimately prove worthless as BC failed to make the postseason for the second-straight year.

item.title: Northeastern Scores Four Unanswered, No. 13 BC Falls 4–2
item.description: Boston College men's hockey went into its game against Northeastern on Saturday hoping to avoid a season sweep and snap its four-game losing streak. Unfortunately for the Eagles, they could not hold on to a two-goal lead as the Huskies took home a 4–2 win on BC's Senior Night.

item.title: Eagles Top No. 24 Miami in Weekend Series for First Ever Series Road Win
item.description: Boston College baseball won its weekend series against No. 24 Miami, earning the Eagles' first ever series win against the Hurricanes on the road.
